content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having an issue when trying to download my program to the [product_name]. I get a 'TOTAL XOR invalide' error, but I don't know what the cause is. If anyone has a solution, please let me know.
Hello, Is the [product_name] you have physically the same type you selected in your software?
In the project I selected [article_no], but the actual hardware is [article_no]. Best regards, [user_name]
Hi, What is a [article_no]? I've never come across such a [product_name] model.
Hi, It's a [company_name] SIPLUS type. Best regards, [user_name]

I ran a test. When programming a single line with one input and one output, it works. When programming a single line with one input and a second input, it doesn't work (TOTAL XOR INVALIDE). For example: ---i i----------() works ---i i-------i i----------() doesn't work (TOTAL XOR INVALIDE) Only one line is in the program. I also tested with a sample program from [company_name] (alternating two compressors) and got the same result (TOTAL XOR NON VALABLE).
Hi, Could you post the program that isn't working? If I have time, I'll take a look. Regards,
Which program would you like—the original (attached in the first post) or the other test version?

Hi, If your program is the one from your first post, it can't be downloaded to a [product_name] [article_no] because it's a UDF, which is only supported by [product_name] [article_no] hardware. Regards,
Hi, That's surprising because I didn't create any UDF!

Hi, Sorry for my earlier mistake. I see you prefer using ladder diagrams. Did you use copy/paste during programming? If so, this could be the issue. Sometimes, copy/pasting in ladder mode can place extra signals into memory without showing them visually, causing download problems. Try switching your program to FBD, press F2 and review any errors listed in the status window, then try downloading again. Hope this helps.

Hello, I found my issue—it was because I was working within VMware (to run Windows XP). When I tried with another laptop without VMware, the original project worked fine. Thanks for your assistance. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user receives a 'TOTAL XOR invalide' error when attempting to download a program to the [product_name], and is unsure about the source of the problem. Discussion centers on hardware version mismatches and the compatibility of features, such as unsupported User Defined Functions for certain hardware versions. Issues with software configuration, programming practices, and virtualization are highlighted.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects their program to successfully download and run on the [product_name] hardware, without unexplained errors or compatibility issues. Clear error explanations and troubleshooting guidance are sought.
